description: A keywordless binding holding an arrow function (`fmt = (n: string) => …`, §50.8.5 — a `const`) and called in markup is a legal binding, never E-MU-001: it is read, and an unread binding would be the S422 lint anyway.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S479-3B-rest-item-25 ("⭐ RULED — the rest of S478 hand-off §3.B, PA recs adopted (S479, 2026-11-18)", item 25: "g-bare-arrow-binding-false-e-mu-001 — Rec (PERMANENT): option (a) — legal const per S422 Calls 1/3 (re-affirmed S479); unused = lint.")
rationale: The gap's own program (S347): impl#1 reported a false `E-MU-001: fmt declared but never used` though `fmt` is called in the `<each>` row. Under the ruling the binding is a `const` and the program has no error.
